production.format_and_medium.summary: If requested, the entity must provide a copy in an electronic format by electronic medium, unless the record was neither created nor available electronically, or doing so would give access to proprietary software or require producing non-separable confidential information.

production.certified_copy.summary: An officer having custody of non-confidential public records must furnish certified copies to any person who requests them and pays or tenders the prescribed copying/certifying fees.

eligibility.any_person.summary: All public books and records of a governmental entity must be open during office hours to inspection by any person, and may be fully copied.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: Access runs to 'any person'; the statute requires no statement of purpose or justification for a request.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: Access runs to 'any person'; the statute imposes no residency or citizenship condition on who may request public records.

dup.bw.rate.unit: USD per page (city sets under actual-cost ceiling)
dup.bw.rate.notes: No statewide per-page figure for municipalities. Prior status said 'delegated to regulation'; NRS 239.052(1)'s 'unless a specific statute or regulation…

dup.color.rate.label: Copy rate — color page
dup.color.rate.unit: USD per page (city sets under actual-cost ceiling)
dup.color.rate.notes: The prior '50 cents' value belongs to NRS 239.052(4) (law-library copies, NV-0024) - it is NOT a color-copy rate and does not apply to a city's ordinary records. Statute draws no B&W/color distinction; a color copy is capped at its actual direct cost (ink/toner/paper).

dup.oversized.rate.label: Copy rate — oversized / nonstandard page
dup.oversized.rate.unit: USD per page/sheet (city sets under actual-cost ceiling)
dup.oversized.rate.notes: No oversized/nonstandard rate in statute or regulation. Prior '50 cents' is the law-library ceiling (NRS 239.052(4)), not an oversized rate. Only record-specific overrides: administrative-proceeding transcripts (NRS 239.053, NV-0025) and GIS data (NRS 239.054, NV-0026).

dup.specialty.rate.label: Specialty reproduction (photos, maps, transcripts)
dup.specialty.rate.unit: USD (city sets under actual-cost ceiling; statutory overrides for transcripts and GIS)
dup.specialty.rate.notes: Photos/maps: actual direct cost of the medium. Two statutory exceptions to the ceiling: (a) certified-court-reporter transcripts of administrative proceedings - mandatory per-page fee equal to the reporter's contract rate plus medium cost (fixed by contract, NV-0025); (b) GIS information - may in…

dup.tiers.label: Graduated page bands (per-page rate by volume)
dup.tiers.notes: No graduated/volume page bands anywhere in NRS 239, NAC 239 or the state-agency manual. Because every copy fee is capped at actual direct cost (NRS 239.052(1)), a city may only band rates if each band still reflects actual cost.

rules.freePages.label: Free page allowance per request
rules.freePages.notes: No free-page allowance. Only category-based free copies: where a specific statute/regulation requires a free copy (NRS 239.052(1), NV-0022; e.g., VA-eligibility certified copies, NRS 239.020, NV-0027). Inspection is free; NRS 239.052 fees attach only to copies.

labor.increment.label: Labor time increment + rounding
labor.increment.notes: Moot: no chargeable labor, so no billing increment. Nothing in NRS 239 / NAC 239 / manual states an increment.

certification.label: Certification / certified-copy charge

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: A governmental entity may charge a fee for a copy, but the fee must not exceed the actual cost to provide the copy unless a specific statute or regulation sets the fee.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: 'Actual cost' means direct cost of providing the copy (ink, toner, paper, media, postage) and excludes any cost the entity incurs regardless of whether a copy is requested.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: A fee for information from a geographic information system may include, in addition to actual medium cost, the reasonable costs of data gathering/entry, database maintenance, hardware, software, quality control, and consultation with personnel.

fee.nonstandard_rate.summary: The fee for a copy of a record in the custody of a governmental law library must not exceed 50 cents per page.

For a copy of a certified-court-reporter transcript of an administrative proceeding, the entity must charge, on top of actual medium cost, a per-page fee equal to the court reporter's contract per-page fee, and remit that amount to the reporter.
fee.nonstandard_rate.clock_spec: fixed: court reporter's contract per-page fee + actual medium cost

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: A governmental entity must not charge a fee for a copy if a specific statute or regulation requires it to provide the copy without charge.
